rl_architectures.architecture: Tier 1: PPO with 4 Separate Model Pools (Actor, Critic, Reference, Reward on Disjoint GPUs + HuggingFace Generate)
Tier 2: Disaggregated Ray + vLLM Rollout Pool (32 GPUs) + Megatron/FSDP Trainer Pool (32 GPUs, Static Split)
Tier 3: veRL 3D-HybridEngine Co-Located Actor/Rollout (Zero-Redundancy TP=8 FSDP <-> TP=2 vLLM Resharding + Sleep Mode)
Tier 4: veRL / slime HybridEngine + FP8 Rollout + Partial-Rollout Long-Tail Straggler Streaming
